note: Rustic Northern Highland-American Legion State Forest campground on Star Lake: sites 1701-1707 near the entrance and 1708-1718 along the road to a loop at the south-west end. Doubles 1704-1705 and 1708-1709. Paved roads, a beach area and a boat landing for campers, and the Star Lake Trail from the campground. Campground attendant mid-May to mid-October. --Claude
summary: DNR rustic camping page + DNR flyer/map read (GoingToCamp refuses, not tried). 18 reservable non-electric sites, 2 vault toilet buildings, 2 hand pumps, beach access, boat landing; season Apr 30-Nov 1 matches the stored manual season. WATERFRONT: lakefront -> lakeview recommended (sites under trees, tree-lined shore; DNR itself captions 'A shady campsite... with a great view of the lake'). Pin to the south-west loop (~260 m). Website dead -> rustic page.
flags: WATERFRONT: stored 'lakefront' (evidence 'lower-loop 1708-1718 along Star Lake shore', not --AWH) -> recommend 'lakeview'. The DNR map shows 1715-1718 nearest the shore, but on leaf-on NAIP and leaf-off Esri imagery the south-west loop (~46.0320,-89.4757) and the 1717-1718 stretch sit in deciduous/pine woods and the shore is tree-lined all along the campground; no named site stands on open ground within ~50 m of the water. The DNR's own photo caption is 'A shady campsite at West Star Lake - with a great view of the lake.' The open water access is the campground's shared beach area and boat landing, not a site.

PIN: stored 46.0335,-89.4724 lies in woods ~90 m south of the campground road, between the entrance cluster (1701-1707) and the south-west loop. Recommend 46.0321,-89.4755 (the 1710-1716 loop, where 11 of the 18 sites sit along the road there; Google's place pin is 46.0320,-89.4753), ~260 m.

DNR GPS ERROR: the DNR rustic page gives West Star Lake as N46 02.003, W89 26.254 (= 46.0334,-89.4376). That point is ~2.7 km east in cut-over forest with no campground on imagery - the minutes look mistyped (26.254 for ~28.4). Don't use it.
